build_yolact_model: build a YOLACT instance segmentation model with ResNet50 backbone and FPN neck for COCO dataset
configure_train_pipeline: configure a training data pipeline with augmentation including expand, random crop, resize, flip, and photo metric distortion
setup_training_schedule: setup a 55-epoch training schedule with linear warmup and multi-step learning rate decay
configure_dataloader: configure train, validation, and test dataloaders with batch size 8 and instance segmentation annotations
setup_optimizer: setup SGD optimizer with learning rate 1e-3, momentum 0.9, and weight decay 5e-4 for YOLACT training
